issues.description: The problem statement and the template declare/expect Farm.singFarmSong() to be a void method that prints the song (the UML and template use void and printing). The solution implementation, however, changes the signature to public String singFarmSong() and returns the whole song as a String. The helper method singFarmSongVerse is also a void printer in the template but returns a String in the solution. This signature/return-type mismatch between template/problem and solution is structural and can confuse students about the required method contract and how they should implement or test the song functionality.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method contract consistent across artifacts. Either: (A) Change the solution to match the specification and template by making singFarmSong() return void and print the song to System.out (and adjust singFarmSongVerse to be a void printer), or (B) Update the problem statement and template to specify that singFarmSong() returns a String (and update the UML and Main usage accordingly). Ensure the helper method signature (singFarmSongVerse) is adjusted consistently as well.
